traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Chloranthaceae: leaves opposite; leaves simple; margins serrate; stipules present; plants hermaphrodite or dioecious; ovary superior or half inferior; stems woody or herbaceous; flowers in spikes, in heads or in panicles; perianth tepals or absent; fruit drupe; stamens 1 to 3 (-5); carpels 1. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
